title: Trunk or Treat
location: Leaksville United Methodist Church, 603 Henry St., Eden
details:
We are invited to  participate by coming with a trunk, volunteering that evening, or donating candy.

If you wish to donate candy, it can be brought by the LUMC church office between the hours of 8:30a until 12:30p, Monday through Friday.

Cars (trunks) and volunteers will need to be in the church parking lot beside the church on Friday, October 30, by 4:00p.
